test_java_tokenizer_discarding_comments: test the Java tokenizer to correctly tokenize Java code while discarding comments
test_java_tokenizer_keeping_comments: test the Java tokenizer to tokenize Java code while preserving comments as tokens
test_java_detokenizer_discarding_comment: test the Java detokenizer to round-trip tokenize and detokenize Java code without comments
test_extract_java_functions: test extracting standalone and class-level functions from tokenized Java source code
test_formatter: test formatting Java code to produce properly indented and spaced output
